title: ADU exterior wall fabrication package (LOD 400 + BOM)
intent: Turn the exterior walls of a one-storey wood-frame ADU into prefabricated wall panels: 2x6 framing, 3/4in plywood, bevel siding, XPS cavity fill; one assembly per wall; shop drawings; BOM and cost.

sequence.do: Build and flex-test component families (lumber, sheet panel, insulation block, siding board)
Write the layout rule (studs 16in o.c., 3-stud corners, double top plate lapped, openings with king/jack/header/sill/cripples, sheets on stud centres, siding courses, foam per cavity)
2D preview from the rule: studs in plan, sheet and board joints in elevations; user confirms or corrects the rule
Resolve design conflicts found by the preview as user decisions (door lowered to fit a header) and re-preview
Replay the rule in 3D per wall; disallow joins on all framing; verify every piece; group into assemblies
Assembly shop drawings: framing and sheathing elevations, plan section, 3D, part list; trade dimension style; PDF review
Quantities and cost from the model; governed BOM parameters
Issue: one shop drawing sheet per panel that differs (identical panels once, with a quantity), add every assembly sheet to the print set, export the set to PDF, open the PDF and check each sheet
Synchronize with central after the package passes its checks, with a comment; on cloud models save local before and after (operating rule in AGENTS.md)

decisions_for_the_user: Conflicts at openings (door height vs. wall height)
discipline_authority: Header sizing over wide openings: structural engineer

changelog.change: Walls under a sloped roof are built to fit it (see ARPL-ASM-0006 v09); issue and sync steps added
